reviews.review_text:
Lyndel T
Perth, Australia4 contributions
0
Incredibly delicious
Jul 2026 • Solo
I’ve eaten a lot of vermicelli with grilled pork over the years and tonight I had the best vermicelli with grilled pork & spring rolls I’ve ever had from Ngoi. Saigon. I could not fault it and I just wish I had found it on my earlier visit to HCMC, not the day before I fly home. 

Going by how incredibly tasty and fresh it was, I can imagine the rest of the dishes would be of the same quality and I would definitely be working my way through the menu if I had more time here. The staff were super friendly and polite too :)

I think the reviewer Dreamer67270678917 (noting it’s their first review) has poorly reviewed the wrong restaurant because their review is so inconsistent with mine and others’ experiences.
